Very nice dinner with excellent service
Jan 2026 • Couples
My husband and I ate at Ly Club as part of a group. We had a private room, so it is difficult to comment on the atmosphere other than to say our room was pleasant. It was a little odd that another group was in an adjoining room, and wait staff had to go through our room to get to theirs. Nonetheless, we had a very nice dinner: pomelo salad with shrimp, scallop and vermicelli cake, salmon, and apple crumble with coconut ice cream. All were delicious with the exception of the salmon, which was a little dry. There was a nice wine selection as well.

I will definitely come back. 👉 If this is your first time here, be sure to look for Pamela first.

Better than the Beaulieu at a 1/4 of the price!!
Jul 2025 • Family
Great evening here. A mixture of Vietnamese and European fair. All beautifully presented. The Flavas were perfectly balanced in the portions. More than adequate wine list was good and not overpriced and the service exemplary. The location was nice and relaxing, air-conditioned, and very comfortable with a French flava. I would most definitely recommend this For an evening. Whilst expensive by Vietnamese standards I managed to feed my family of four with drinks and a few cocktails for 200 aud (120usd). The foie gras was the stand out and well worth the money.
